Done. I posted the bullets in #coastal-team as a reply to your message, and saved a draft to June Osei-Lark (joseilark@pemberline.com) for you to review and send. Nothing was sent.

- Pellow Home Living was renamed from Covey & Lark Retail on 16 Feb 2026, and the CRM code changed from CLR to PHL.
- PHL is also the code for Pellucid Harbor Logistics, so a PHL filter returns both accounts. Use the full account name in subject lines and dropdowns.
- The saved report still reads "Covey — Late Arrivals" and needs the Pellow Home Living name.
- Older exports and some yard reports still show the Covey & Lark header.
